title: Beach Still My Heart
meta_description: Spacious 4BR Blue Mountain Beach home with screened porch, bikes, pool, \& easy beach access---perfect for family 30A getaways!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: This charming coastal home located in the Lakeside neighborhood of Blue Mountain, has everything you could want in your home away from home. Step inside Beach Still My Heart and be met with coastal decor, open living space, large screened in porch with a table and chairs, and beautiful artwork. Thoughtfully designed with two master suites, two additional guest bedrooms, and outdoor living on both levels, this home provides plenty of room to relax, rejuvenate, and enjoy your 30A getaway. A golf cart is included, making beach runs and exploring 30A even easier. The open concept kitchen and living room will be the perfect spot to enjoy family meals and watching the game together.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is a coastal community that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park and is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. Spend your mornings grabbing coffee and pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery and evenings strolling to dinner at Blue Mabel Restaurant. Don't forget to grab dessert, or better yet, don't wait for dessert! Stop by Blue Mountain Beach Creamery after your bike ride or day at the beach to find out why so many argue that it's the best ice cream in town. Beach Still My Heart is located adjacent to the Redfish Village where you'll find charming specialty boutiques and dining.

BEACH ACCESS: The Lakeside neighborhood is about a 10-minute walk to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access. There are restrooms, shower, some parking and coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 - first floor- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 --second floor- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 -- second floor-1 King, 1 Twin with Trundle
• Bunk room --second floor- 1 Twin over Full

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Centrally located community pool
• 2 Bikes
• Complimentary Golf Cart (included)
• Gas Grill -- Propane
• Screened in porch with dining table, sofa \& chairs
• Front porch with twin daybed swing
• Outdoor shower
• Smart TVs in every bedroom with roku stick and YouTube TV
• Coffee Maker -- both
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 3 parking spaces with overflow parking available in town. Passes are required in front space.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
